public.text: Phase 1 establishes the architecture governance body, stakeholders and evaluation plan, but does not explicitly establish clinical-safety governance before implementation. Deferring this function risks treating clinical assurance as a late implementation check rather than a design constraint carried through procurement, configuration, testing and deployment.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a Phase 1 deliverable to establish the clinical-governance and patient-safety workstream, including a named accountable lead, a DPI-H hazard/risk log, clinical acceptance criteria, escalation and incident routes, and requirements for frontline clinical and service-user participation. Carry these controls through procurement, testing, go-live and post-deployment evaluation.
